purpose: One-shot preflight using the exact tokenizers-cpp C FFI exported by the existing pinned Android runtime; no model or NPU initialization.

ffi.rust_dependency_note: Cargo.toml specifies tokenizers 0.21.2 via semver; no committed Cargo.lock was present in the inspected tree. The actual Android library SHA pins the implementation. No unverified Unicode crate version is claimed.

tokenizer.normalization_handling: Performed by the pinned library on original UTF-8 bytes; the helper does not normalize, truncate, or approximate it with Python.

formatter.input_marker_policy: Reject literal reserved image marker in either input, matching the actual processor.
formatter.no_image: Encode the complete ChatML text as one segment with flag 0.
formatter.one_image: Encode exactly the substring before the actual image marker and the substring after it as two separate segments with flag 0, matching the processor's splice algorithm.
formatter.jinja_note: The QAIRT Qwen3-VL processor uses the fixed manual formatter, not tokenizer_config.json's Jinja template.

supervision.required: Parent pins helper/library/tokenizer; uses reviewed native executor and counter && exec worker in one process group; validates request/input/formatter/artifact hashes and native terminal evidence. Counter JSON is not a process receipt.
supervision.signals: Default TERM/INT/HUP cancellation and a 3-second SIGALRM may end with no published result. No such outcome is success.
supervision.rust_panic: A malformed runtime/tokenizer or panic may abort; caller must reject nonzero exit or absence of complete count result.
supervision.mutation: Original input/ELF FDs and names are checked for unchanged device/inode/mode/owner/link/size/times before publishing; library is loaded using its open SHA-checked FD.
supervision.unvalidated: Android linker/SELinux load, 3-second real-device timing, actual tokenizer counts against recorded SDK profiles, and production integration remain separate gates.

host_validation.scope: Real host C process and filesystem tests with explicitly synthetic tokenizers-cpp ABI library. These are not fixed19 acceptance cases, real tokenizer measurements, or phone/NPU tests.
host_validation.fixture_note: Only a <=1024-byte tokenizer fixture beginning with {"hepta_tokenizer_host_fixture_v1": enables controlled faults. Real vocabulary words never activate faults. Default host stub counts bytes, not model tokens.
